acquisition method: The digest was analyzed using the data-dependent multitask capability of the instrument... The targeted experiments involve the analysis of specific βIV-spectrin peptides
alkylation reagent: alkylated with iodoacetamide prior to the in-gel digestion
cleavage agent: adding 5 μl of 10 ng/μl trypsin in 50 mM ammonium bicarbonate
enrichment method: purified using Anti-HA antibody (3724; Cell Signaling) loaded onto TrueBlot agarose beads
fractionation method: The protein samples were fractionated on an SDS-PAGE
fragmentation method: The data were analyzed by using all collision-induced dissociation spectra collected in the experiment
instrument: interfacing with a ThermoScientific Fusion Lumos mass spectrometer system
ionization type: The microelectrospray ion source is operated at 2.5 kV
labeling: The protein samples were fractionated on an SDS-PAGE and submitted for analysis
precursor tolerance: The precursor mass tolerance for these searches was set to 10 ppm
fragment tolerance: the fragment ion mass tolerance was set to 0.6 Da
ptm: Oxidation of methionine (dynamic); acetylation of protein N terminus (dynamic); phosphorylation at S, T, and Y (dynamic); Carbamidomethylated cysteine (static)
Oxidation of methionine, acetylation of protein N terminus, and phosphorylation at S, T, and Y were set as dynamic modifications. Carbamidomethylated cysteine was set as a static modification.
reduction reagent: The bands were then reduced with DTT
